note: Re-judged 2026-11-19 after xfrmStateFromParams gained the XFRMA_SA_DIR mapping (xfrmSADirFromParams) and the outbound anti-replay refusal (3977cef525). RFC 4301 Section 4.2: "Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm." Neither change touches the transform plan: planStateAlgos and xfrmAuthName still require an Auth transform on every non-AEAD ESP state, and an absent or none integrity algorithm is still refused before a state is returned. boundarySA now carries no replay window (outbound), so the ESP-null fixtures still build. vpp.go changed only in comments outside vppCryptoAlg and vppIntegAlg. The tagged units are unchanged: TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithIntegrityIsInstantiated asserts the null cipher with HMAC-SHA-256; TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused requires an error and a nil state for absent and none integrity; the VPP negative requires ErrNotSupported and no SAD message beside a valid-SA control; the OSPF pair refuses absent integrity and accepts SHA-256. Verdict stands.
